attribute.description: Number of threads that implement the final phase of event building - create ROB fragments and pass them to consumers

attribute.description: If this value is set to 1 then corrupted data packets will be dropped

attribute.name: UnsubscribeDisabledLinks
attribute.description: If this value is set to 1 then SW ROD will unsubscribe from the stoplessly removed input links, otherwise just mark them as disabled and discard all data received from them.

attribute.name: FlushBufferAtStop
attribute.description: If set to true flushes input buffers when Stop-of-Run command received and immediatley stops data processing. Otherwise keeps working until buffers get empty.

attribute.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for a specific L1 Accept packet to arrive

attribute.name: MaxMessageSize
attribute.description: The maximum size of a data packet. Packets of larger size will be either discarded or truncated depending on the specific algorithm implementation.

attribute.name: ResynchTimeout
attribute.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the fragment with the last known L1 ID been built

attribute.name: PacketDumpPath
attribute.description: Directory to store files with dumps of corrupted packets

attribute.name: PacketDumpLimit
attribute.description: Maximum number of packets to dump per E-Link

attribute.name: LinkLoggingLimit
attribute.description: Maximum number of issues reported per E-Link

attribute.name: AssemblyBufferSize
attribute.description: Maximum number of ROB fagments with either L1 Accept or data packets been missed that can be simultaneusly kept in memory.

attribute.name: AddPacketHeader
attribute.description: If set to true, each data packet in the fragment payload will be preceeded by 8-bytes header that cntains the packet size, error status and detector specific E-Link ID.

attribute.name: LinkSubscriptionMask
attribute.description: This mask is applied to E-Link IDs and the resulting value is used to group E-Links to the data receiving threads if the number of the groups is equal to the number of these threads as defined by the SwRodModule::WorkersNumber parameter. Otherwise the mask will be ignored and the E-Links will be equally split between the data receiving threads based on the order of their appearence in the SwRodDataChannel::Contains relationship.

attribute.description: Maximum size (# of ROB fragments) of the buffer for aggregating data chunks from differnt E-Links. This value defines a maximum number of ROB fragments that can be built concurrently.

attribute.name: MinimumBufferSize
attribute.description: Minimum size (# of ROB fragments) of the data aggregation buffer.

attribute.name: RecoveryDepth
attribute.description: Maximum number of L1A packets to be checked if the latest data and L1A packets don't matcheach other. If no matchis is found the algorithm behavior will depend on the value of the DropCorruptedPackets parameter

attribute.name: DataReceivingTimeout
attribute.description: Timeout in milliseconds for all data packets with a given L1 ID to arrive. Zero means waiting until the main buffer gets full. The size of the buffer is set via the BufferSize property of the same object.

attribute.name: L1AInitiatesTimeout
attribute.description: If this value is set to 1 then data receiving timeout will be activated when the corresponding L1A packet is received. Otherwise the timeout is applied to the interval between receving the first and the last data packets with the given L1ID.

attribute.description: The maximum size of a data packet. Packets of larger size will be discarded.
